name: rsvp-form
title: RSVP form
description: Reply to an invitation: name, yes or no, number of guests, dietary needs and a message, with a warm confirmation.
docs: Pass the event (name, startsAt, timeZone and place), onSubmit and, as you need them, maxGuests (the most guests one reply can bring, not counting the person replying: 2 by default, and 0 leaves the guest count out), dietary (the needs to tick), deadline and calendarHref. onSubmit receives the name, whether they are coming, the number of guests, the dietary needs and the message, and may be async: resolve to confirm, reject to show the error and keep everything typed. Yes and no are two large radio cards, one above the other and side by side only once the form is wide enough for both to hold their words; choosing no takes the guest count and the dietary needs away, so nobody answers what does not apply. Mistakes are said in words once the reader has been in a field or tried to send, and the first one takes focus. The confirmation repeats the answer in words (Sanne, we have you down as coming with 1 guest), lists the dietary needs noted, offers Add to calendar to people who are coming (a data: URL or an .ics file you supply) and has Change my answer, which reopens the form with every answer as it was and puts focus on the first field. The date is written in the event's time zone without naming it, because the guests are there. defaultStatus done with defaultValues starts on the confirmation. labels translates every fixed word, errors included.
